description: Image block. The empty editable state shows a drag-and-drop upload zone and dialog; the filled state shows the image with a replace button and left, center, and full-width alignment controls, plus an editable caption.

parameters.name: OnCaptionSaved
parameters.description: Raised on caption blur when text changed. Null = empty.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the block requests deletion.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Raised when the component receives focus.

parameters.name: OnMediaSet
parameters.description: Raised when the user sets a new image (URL or uploaded file).

parameters.name: OnWidthChanged
parameters.description: Raised when resize drag ends. Arg = new pixel width.
